# clickup_tracked_time (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `task_id` (String)

### Optional

- `custom_task_ids` (Boolean) If you want to reference a task by it's custom task id, this value must be `true`.
- `team_id` (Number) When the `custom_task_ids` parameter is set to `true`, the Workspace ID must be provided using the `team_id` parameter.
 \
For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`.
